title: GROUP BY worked example
body: SELECT question_id, COUNT(is_correct) FILTER (WHERE is_correct) * 1.0 / COUNT(is_correct) AS rate FROM attempt GROUP BY question_id;

title: JOIN with Topic
body: SELECT t.topic_name, AVG(a.is_correct::int) FROM attempt a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.question_id JOIN topic t ON q.topic_id = t.topic_id GROUP BY t.topic_name;
